it's terrible... I don't want to... think about it again...

anyways, apart from that terrible story... you saved me here...

[Dew]

Now!!

scripts.text: Bang!!!

scripts.text:

It hurts!!!

You're here...

[塔馬林]

scripts.text:
[Mansion Manager ��]
...Do you happen to have a party with you?
scripts.translation:
[宅邸管理員]
......請問您是和隊伍一起來的嗎？

scripts.text: I came with the Rebellions and some government officials.
scripts.translation: 我是和反叛軍及幾位政府官員一起來的。

scripts.text:
[Mansion Manager ��]
Excuse me. {0}, I will issue you a formal guest license right away.
scripts.translation:
[宅邸管理員]
不好意思，{0}，我馬上為您簽發正式訪客許可證。

scripts.text: What? Suddenly?
scripts.translation: 什麼？怎麼突然......？

scripts.text:
[Mansion Manager ��]
I registered after confirming the identity and purpose of the visit of the other party members who came together from other places in the mansion.
scripts.translation:
[宅邸管理員]
我核實了從宅邸其他地方趕來的同行者身份和來訪目的，併為他們辦理了登記。

scripts.text:
[Mansion Manager ��]
Your ^0000CDparty^000000 has been granted formal status automatically because they were from the ^0000CDsame party^000000 who visited this mansion the other day.
scripts.translation:
[宅邸管理員]
由於您的^0000CD隊伍^000000與前幾天來訪的^0000CD隊伍相同^000000，已自動獲准正式進入。

scripts.text:
[Mansion Manager ��]
In addition, they have also stated that, you have come here to ^0000CDcatch the intruders^000000 who are making a disturbance inside the mansion.
scripts.translation:
[宅邸管理員]
此外，他們還說明，您此行是為了^0000CD抓捕^000000在宅邸內製造騷亂的入侵者。

scripts.text:
[Mansion Manager ��]
Therefore, we will also issue a formal guest license for the mansion to your party, {0}
scripts.translation:
[宅邸管理員]
因此，我們也會為您的隊伍簽發正式訪客許可證，{0}。

scripts.text:
[Mansion Manager ��]
Please wait a moment.
scripts.translation:
[宅邸管理員]
請稍等片刻。

scripts.text:
[Mansion Manager ��]
{0}. Welcome to the Varmundt's Mansion. Nice to meet you. I'm �� the manager of this mansion.
scripts.translation:
[宅邸管理員]
{0}，歡迎來到瓦爾蒙特宅邸。很高興認識您。我是宅邸的管理員。

scripts.text:
[Mansion Manager ��]
From now on. {0}, As a guest of honor, you are free to use the facilities in this mansion. If you have any question, please feel free to contact the nearest automatic dolls.
scripts.translation:
[宅邸管理員]
從現在起，{0}，您作為貴賓可以自由使用宅邸設施。如有疑問，請聯絡最近的自動人偶。

scripts.text:
[Mansion Manager ��]
Also, if you need help cleaning up and information about the intruders in the mansion, we will fully cooperate.
To that end, we've opened the outside of the mansion to the general public.
scripts.translation:
[宅邸管理員]
如果您需要協助清理現場，或想了解宅邸內入侵者的情況，我們會全力配合。
為此，我們已向公眾開放宅邸外圍區域。

scripts.text: Thank you.
scripts.translation: 謝謝。

scripts.text:
[Mansion Manager ��]
I'll share the list of the new registered guests with {0} to the other automatic dolls.
scripts.translation:
[宅邸管理員]
我會把新登記的訪客名單同步給{0}和其他自動人偶。

scripts.text:
[Mansion Manager ��]
{0}, all of the automatic dolls in the mansion are... dear... oh...
scripts.translation:
[宅邸管理員]
{0}，宅邸裡的自動人偶全都是......親愛的......哦......

scripts.text:
[Mansion Manager ��]
I'm sorry, please wait a moment.
scripts.translation:
[宅邸管理員]
抱歉，請稍等片刻。

scripts.text:
[Mansion Manager ��]
Again... trouble...
scripts.translation:
[宅邸管理員]
又......出問題了......

scripts.text: Is there a problem?
scripts.translation: 出什麼問題了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mansion Manager ��]
There's a problem with the ^0000CDrepeaters^000000 in some areas. The signal is not transmitting or not being received.
scripts.translation:
[宅邸管理員]
部分割槽域的^0000CD中繼器^000000出了故障，訊號無法傳送或接收。

scripts.text: Repeater?
scripts.translation: 中繼器？

scripts.text:
[Mansion Manager ��]
All the automatic dolls in the mansion are connected to a wireless network.
We use that network to share information to every automatic dolls in the mansion in an instant.
scripts.translation:
[宅邸管理員]
宅邸裡的自動人偶都連線在無線網路上。
通過這個網路，我們能瞬間把資訊同步給宅邸裡的所有自動人偶。

scripts.text:
[Mansion Manager ��]
It's important for things like, guest registration and schedules sharing.
scripts.translation:
[宅邸管理員]
訪客登記、日程共享等工作都離不開它。

scripts.text:
[Mansion Manager ��]
If you want to relay an information to anywhere in the mansion. Use the repeater to relay the information to all automatic dolls.
scripts.translation:
[宅邸管理員]
如果要把訊息傳到宅邸各處，就得通過中繼器轉發給所有自動人偶。

scripts.text:
[Mansion Manager ��]
I have already send the information of the updated guest lists. But, I haven't received a confirmation from some automatic dolls.
scripts.translation:
[宅邸管理員]
我已經發送了更新後的訪客名單，但有些自動人偶還沒有確認收到。

scripts.text:
[Mansion Manager ��]
The repeater in the area where the signal is not transmitting has failed.
scripts.translation:
[宅邸管理員]
訊號無法傳出的區域，中繼器已經損壞了。

scripts.text: Does it break down often?
scripts.translation: 這種故障經常發生嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mansion Manager ��]
Failure is not frequent because we meticulously maintain it.
However, when the ^0000CDintruders^000000 entered the mansion the other day, they disassembled and extorted the facilities in the mansion.
scripts.translation:
[宅邸管理員]
我們維護得很仔細，所以故障並不常見。
不過前幾天^0000CD入侵者^000000闖入宅邸時，拆卸並掠走了這裡的設施。

scripts.text:
[Mansion Manager ��]
Some automatic dolls were destroyed by the intruders.
scripts.translation:
[宅邸管理員]
有些自動人偶被入侵者破壞了。

scripts.text:
[Mansion Manager ��]
I'll have to check which area's repeater is not functioning properly.
scripts.translation:
[宅邸管理員]
我得查查哪個區域的中繼器出了故障。

scripts.text:
[Mansion Manager ��]
I apologize, but could you wait a little longer? I have to check which area is the problem and manually forward the updated guest list.
scripts.translation:
[宅邸管理員]
抱歉，請再稍等一會兒。我得查明故障區域，並手動轉發更新後的訪客名單。

scripts.text:
[Mansion Manager ��]
Our of the 20 repeaters, only three have not responded. I'm glad that the count is small. We'll go the place where the signal can't get through to manually pass through the updated guest list. We also need to check the repeaters.
scripts.translation:
[宅邸管理員]
20臺中繼器裡只有3臺沒有回應，幸好數量不多。
我們去訊號無法通過的區域，手動傳遞更新後的訪客名單，同時檢查中繼器。

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
Is it here??
scripts.translation:
[湯米]
是這裡嗎？

scripts.text:
[Meimei]
Oh, adventurer, here you are.
scripts.translation:
[美美]
哦，冒險者，你來了。

scripts.text:
[Mansion Manager ��]
Another person. Are they a part of your party?
scripts.translation:
[宅邸管理員]
又來了一位。是和您同行的嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, I'm with them.
scripts.translation: 是的，我和他們一起來的。

scripts.text:
[Meimei]
Wow, this is the mansion. Varmundt's Mansion!
scripts.translation:
[美美]
哇，這就是瓦爾蒙特宅邸！

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
Adventurer! The movement of the Illusions has been confirmed inside the mansion. Soon we're going to form a team, figure out the structure of the mansion, and start the operation.
scripts.translation:
[湯米]
冒險者！已確認宅邸裡有幻影在活動。我們很快會組隊摸清宅邸結構，然後開始行動。

scripts.text: I'll be waiting.
scripts.translation: 我等著。

scripts.text:
[Mansion Manager ��]
If you're new, please come this way. I'll officially register you as a guest of the mansion.
scripts.translation:
[宅邸管理員]
如果您是新來的，請到這邊來。我會為您正式辦理宅邸訪客登記。

scripts.text:
[Mansion Manager ��]
Oh, before that... {0}, have you looked around the mansion?
scripts.translation:
[宅邸管理員]
哦，在那之前......{0}，您參觀過宅邸了嗎？

scripts.text: Not yet.
scripts.translation: 還沒準備好。

scripts.text:
[Mansion Manager ��]
Then, may I take the liberty of asking you a favor? I didn't mean to eavesdrop, but you said you needed to figure out the structure of the mansion.
scripts.translation:
[宅邸管理員]
那麼，能否冒昧請您幫個忙？我不是有意偷聽，不過聽到您說需要弄清宅邸的結構。

scripts.text:
[Mansion Manager ��]
Can you tell the automatic dolls near the broken repeater to check the broken repeater?
scripts.translation:
[宅邸管理員]
能否請您告訴故障中繼器附近的自動人偶，讓它們檢查中繼器？

scripts.text:
[Mansion Manager ��]
It's a good course to take a look around the mansion.
scripts.translation:
[宅邸管理員]
順便在宅邸裡四處看看也是個不錯的主意。

scripts.text:
[Mansion Manager ��]
It's my job, but I don't have enough time to register, update and share information manually since guests are still coming in.
scripts.translation:
[宅邸管理員]
這是我的職責，但訪客接連到來，我實在抽不出時間手動登記、更新並共享資訊。

scripts.text: I'll do that.
scripts.translation: 我來幫忙。

scripts.text: I need to do something first.
scripts.translation: 我還有別的事要先處理。

scripts.text:
[Mansion Manager ��]
Is that so, I'm sorry for asking too much on your busy schedule.
Feel free to look around the mansion.
scripts.translation:
[宅邸管理員]
這樣啊，抱歉在您忙碌時提出這麼多請求。請隨意參觀宅邸。

scripts.text:
[Mansion Manager ��]
Thank you for accepting my troublesome request.
There are automatic dolls who haven't receieve the updated guest list yet, but we have officially granted {0} as a guest. The dolls will recognize you as you get close to them.
scripts.translation:
[宅邸管理員]
感謝您答應幫這個忙。
有些自動人偶還沒收到更新後的訪客名單，不過我們已經正式登記{0}為訪客。您靠近時，它們就會認出您。

scripts.text:
[Mansion Manager ��]
Everyone else has received the list, so it won't be that inconvenient to use the mansion. If you need any assistance, feel free to contact the nearest automatic doll.
scripts.translation:
[宅邸管理員]
其他人都已收到名單，所以使用宅邸設施應該不會太不方便。如需協助，請聯絡最近的自動人偶。

scripts.text:
[Mansion Manager ��]
First, the nearest is the <NAVI>[restaurant]<INFO>ba_maison,146,109,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>. You should go over there. If you tell the nearest automatic doll near the repeater about the problem, they will take care of it for you.
scripts.translation:
[宅邸管理員]
最近的是<NAVI>[餐廳]<INFO>ba_maison,146,109,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>，請先去那裡。把中繼器故障的事告訴附近的自動人偶，它們會處理。

scripts.text:
[Mansion Manager ��]
Then, please.
scripts.translation:
[宅邸管理員]
那就拜託您了。

scripts.text:
[Mansion Manager ��]
First, the nearest is the <NAVI>[restaurant]<INFO>ba_maison,146,109,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>. You should go over there. If you tell the nearest automatic doll near the repeater about the problem, they will take care of it for you.
scripts.translation:
[宅邸管理員]
最近的是<NAVI>[餐廳]<INFO>ba_maison,146,109,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>，請先去那裡。把中繼器故障的事告訴附近的自動人偶，它們會處理。

scripts.text:
[Mansion Manager ��]
The <NAVI>[pavilion]<INFO>ba_maison,334,143,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> is this way. Automatic doll over there will take care of the broken repeater if you deliver it.
scripts.translation:
[宅邸管理員]
<NAVI>[涼亭]<INFO>ba_maison,334,143,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>在這邊。把情況告訴那裡的自動人偶，它會處理故障中繼器。

scripts.text:
[Mansion Manager ��]
Tell the problem to the automatic doll near the broken repeater on the <NAVI>[central garden]<INFO>ba_maison,245,206,0,0,0</INFO></NAVI> area and it will take care of it.
scripts.translation:
[宅邸管理員]
請把情況告訴<NAVI>[中央花園]<INFO>ba_maison,245,206,0,0,0</INFO></NAVI>故障中繼器附近的自動人偶，它會處理。

scripts.text:
[Mansion Manager ��]
{0}, welcome back. Have you looked around the mansion? Also, did you delivered the message to the automatic dolls near the broken repeater's area?
scripts.translation:
[宅邸管理員]
{0}，歡迎回來。參觀過宅邸了嗎？也把訊息送給故障區域附近的自動人偶了嗎？

scripts.text: I delivered them all.
scripts.translation: 都送到了。

scripts.text:
[Mansion Manager ��]
Thank you so much for your hard work. Let me check the network status for a moment.
scripts.translation:
[宅邸管理員]
辛苦您了，非常感謝。請讓我檢查一下網路狀態。

scripts.text:
[Mansion Manager ��]
The network of the mansion has been restored and the signals in all areas are being sent and received clearly.
Now, you can use all the facilities of the mansion as an official guest.
scripts.translation:
[宅邸管理員]
宅邸網路已經恢復，所有區域的訊號都能正常收發。
現在您可以作為正式訪客使用宅邸的所有設施了。

scripts.text:
[Mansion Manager ��]
{0}, Thank you very much.
You handled this troublesome intruders very well. It gave me an impression that, you're a very skilled adventurer who handles this kind of situation splendidly.
scripts.translation:
[宅邸管理員]
{0}，非常感謝。
您妥善處理了這些棘手的入侵者，讓我印象深刻。您是一位很有本領、能出色應對這類情況的冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Mansion Manager ��]
You quickly learned the geography of the mansion, and you quickly become accustomed with the automatic dolls. It was impressive.
scripts.translation:
[宅邸管理員]
您很快就熟悉了宅邸的佈局，也很快適應了自動人偶，真令人佩服。

scripts.text:
[Mansion Manager ��]
Please take a look around the mansion and if you ever find any problems, I would like to ask for your help.
scripts.translation:
[宅邸管理員]
請繼續參觀宅邸。如果發現任何問題，希望您能幫忙處理。

scripts.text:
[Mansion Manager ��]
We automatic dolls serve the human guests as how we served the owner of the mansion, we are already familiar with it. But we have insufficient information and response skills to unfamiliar problems.
scripts.translation:
[宅邸管理員]
我們自動人偶服務人類賓客的方式，與服務宅邸主人時相同，這方面已經很熟練了。
但遇到陌生的問題時，我們掌握的資訊和應對能力都不足。

scripts.text:
[Mansion Manager ��]
We still haven't resolved the problem with the intruders. From a non-human perspective, it seems difficult to resolve it because there are many parts that doesn't have enough information.
scripts.translation:
[宅邸管理員]
入侵者造成的問題還沒有解決。從非人類的角度來看，許多情況缺乏足夠的資訊，處理起來很困難。

scripts.text:
[Mansion Manager ��]
We would like to collect resolving intruder problems related data through {0}, It will be a great help in future cases.
scripts.translation:
[宅邸管理員]
我們想通過{0}收集處理入侵者問題的資料，以便應對今後的類似事件。

scripts.text: Okay.
scripts.translation: 好的。

scripts.text:
[Mansion Manager ��]
It's not much, but as a token of appreciation, I will give you this.
This is a ^0000CDBarmeal Ticket^000000, you can use it in the mansion's restaurant.
You can freely eat anything with it, feel free to use it anytime.
scripts.translation:
[宅邸管理員]
這只是小小心意，請收下。
這是^0000CD餐券^000000，能在宅邸餐廳使用。
可以隨意享用餐點，想用時儘管用。

scripts.text:
[Mansion Manager ��]
The mansion's <NAVI>[restaurant]<INFO>ba_maison,146,109,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> is located at the bottom, as I showed earlier.
scripts.translation:
[宅邸管理員]
宅邸的<NAVI>[餐廳]<INFO>ba_maison,146,109,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>就在下層，位置和我剛才指的一樣。

scripts.text: Have you seen my party?
scripts.translation: 你看到我的隊伍了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mansion Manager ��]
Those who came before you are now staying at the <NAVI>[tea house]<INFO>ba_in01,206,106,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>, please take a look around and talk with them.
scripts.translation:
[宅邸管理員]
比您先到的同伴目前住在<NAVI>[茶室]<INFO>ba_in01,206,106,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>。請去看看並和他們聊聊。

scripts.text:
[Mansion Manager ��]
If you have any inconvenience in the mansion, please feel free to tell any automatic dolls. Please take this Barmeal Ticket, as a token of appreciation for your hard work.
scripts.translation:
[宅邸管理員]
如果在宅邸裡遇到不便，請隨時告訴任一自動人偶。也請收下這張餐券，感謝您的辛勞。

scripts.text:
[Mansion Manager ��]
Welcome, {0}.
scripts.translation:
[宅邸管理員]
歡迎您，{0}。

scripts.text:
[Mansion Manager ��]
Those who came before you are now staying at the <NAVI>[tea house]<INFO>ba_in01,206,106,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>, please take a look around and talk with them.
scripts.translation:
[宅邸管理員]
比您先到的同伴目前住在<NAVI>[茶室]<INFO>ba_in01,206,106,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>。請去看看並和他們聊聊。

scripts.text:
[Mansion Manager ��]
Do you have something you need or are you uncomfortable in any ways?
Oh, by any chance did you come to bring me a spare communication chips for the repeater?
scripts.translation:
[宅邸管理員]
在宅邸裡遇到不便，或有什麼需要，請儘管告訴自動人偶。
哦，您是來送中繼器備用通訊晶片的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mansion Manager ��]
The supply of the repeater's communication chips is sufficient.
Don't worry about the repeater. Please rest for today and come back ^0000CDafter dawn^000000.
scripts.translation:
[宅邸管理員]
中繼器的通訊晶片儲備充足。暫時不用擔心，請今天先休息，^0000CD天亮後^000000再來。

scripts.text:
[Mansion Manager ��]
Are you here today to help me get spare communication chips for the repeater?
scripts.translation:
[宅邸管理員]
您今天是來幫忙收集中繼器備用通訊晶片的嗎？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是。

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不是。

scripts.text:
[Mansion Manager ��]
In that case, did you come here because of any inconvenience while using the mansion facilities?
If you tell the nearest automatic doll, we'll take care of it right away.
scripts.translation:
[宅邸管理員]
那麼，您是使用宅邸設施時遇到了不便嗎？告訴最近的自動人偶，我們會立刻處理。

scripts.text:
[Mansion Manager ��]
Thank you so much for your help today.
scripts.translation:
[宅邸管理員]
非常感謝您今天的幫助。

scripts.text:
[Mansion Manager ��]
Please bring me ^0000CD10 Automatic Doll Communication Chips^000000 for the repeater. I think that will be enough for the days supply.
scripts.translation:
[宅邸管理員]
請給我^0000CD10個自動人偶通訊晶片^000000，供中繼器使用。我想這些夠用幾天了。

scripts.text:
[Mansion Manager ��]
It also help us with the broken automatic dolls roaming around the mansion. Please take care of any Broken Betas roaming around the mansion and bring it's communication chips with you.
scripts.translation:
[宅邸管理員]
這些晶片也能幫助我們處理在宅邸裡遊蕩的故障自動人偶。請擊退遊蕩的故障貝塔，並帶回它們的通訊晶片。

scripts.text:
[Mansion Manager ��]
Then, please adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[宅邸管理員]
那麼就拜託您了，冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Mansion Manager ��]
Do you have something you need or are you uncomfortable in any ways?
scripts.translation:
[宅邸管理員]
有什麼需要，或者覺得哪裡不方便嗎？

scripts.text: Is the network working fine?
scripts.translation: 網路執行正常嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mansion Manager ��]
Are you here for that matter? Thank you very much for your concern.
scripts.translation:
[宅邸管理員]
您是為這件事來的？非常感謝您的關心。

scripts.text:
[Mansion Manager ��]
Just like the previous situation, the network status in some area of the mansion are losing connectivity.
scripts.translation:
[宅邸管理員]
和上次一樣，宅邸部分割槽域的網路連線又中斷了。

scripts.text:
[Mansion Manager ��]
Although it's repaired upon discovery, it's a problem that occurs continuously. The necessary communication chips demand are difficult to supply.
scripts.translation:
[宅邸管理員]
雖然發現後都會立即修復，但故障不斷發生，所需通訊晶片也很難補足。

scripts.text:
[Mansion Manager ��]
In addition, the broken automatic dolls is wandering around and keeps destroying the repeaters, doubling the supply needed.
scripts.translation:
[宅邸管理員]
此外，故障自動人偶四處遊蕩，不斷破壞中繼器，所需晶片數量因此翻倍。

scripts.text: Can I help?
scripts.translation: 我能幫忙嗎？

scripts.text: Oh, that must be difficult.
scripts.translation: 聽起來真棘手。

scripts.text:
[Mansion Manager ��]
Thank you for considering the difficulties. We will take care of the repeater as soon as possible so that there will be no inconvenience when using it.
scripts.translation:
[宅邸管理員]
感謝您體諒我們的難處。我們會盡快修好中繼器，確保使用設施時不受影響。

scripts.text:
[Mansion Manager ��]
Thank you very much. But I'm afraid that I'm taking too much of your time {0}... If you don't mind at all, I'd like to ask you a favor.
scripts.translation:
[宅邸管理員]
非常感謝。不過我擔心佔用了您太多時間，{0}......如果您不介意，我還想請您幫個忙。

scripts.text:
[Mansion Manager ��]
Please bring me ^0000CD10 Automatic Doll Communication Chips^000000 for the repeater. I think that will be enough for the days supply.
scripts.translation:
[宅邸管理員]
請給我^0000CD10個自動人偶通訊晶片^000000，供中繼器使用。我想這些夠用幾天了。

scripts.text:
[Mansion Manager ��]
It also help us with the broken automatic dolls roaming around the mansion. Please take care of any Broken Betas roaming around the mansion and bring it's communication chips with you.
scripts.translation:
[宅邸管理員]
這些晶片也能幫助我們處理在宅邸裡遊蕩的故障自動人偶。請擊退遊蕩的故障貝塔，並帶回它們的通訊晶片。

scripts.text:
[Mansion Manager ��]
Then, please adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[宅邸管理員]
那麼就拜託您了，冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Mansion Manager ��]
Did you bring the Automatic Doll Communication Chips that I asked for?
scripts.translation:
[宅邸管理員]
您帶來我拜託您收集的自動人偶通訊晶片了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mansion Manager ��]
Please bring me ^0000CD10 Automatic Doll Communication Chips^000000 for the repeater. I think that will be enough for the days supply.
scripts.translation:
[宅邸管理員]
請給我^0000CD10個自動人偶通訊晶片^000000，供中繼器使用。我想這些夠用幾天了。

scripts.text:
[Mansion Manager ��]
It also help us with the broken automatic dolls roaming around the mansion. Please take care of any Broken Betas roaming around the mansion and bring its communication chips with you.
scripts.translation:
[宅邸管理員]
這些晶片也能幫助我們處理在宅邸裡遊蕩的故障自動人偶。請擊退遊蕩的故障貝塔，並帶回它們的通訊晶片。

scripts.text:
[Mansion Manager ��]
This is enough for the day. Thank you for your hard work.
If you have time, I'd like to ask for your help again ^0000CDafter dawn^000000, If you don't mind please come again tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[宅邸管理員]
今天的用量夠了。辛苦您了。
如果有時間，^0000CD天亮後^000000還想再請您幫忙。方便的話，明天再來吧。

scripts.text:
[Mansion Manager ��]
Thank you very much. Please take this with you.
scripts.translation:
[宅邸管理員]
非常感謝，請收下這個。

scripts.text:
The number of items in your possession is too high, so you cannot proceed with the conversation.
Please clean up your inventory and try again.
scripts.translation:
你攜帶的物品太多，無法繼續交談。
請整理物品欄後再試。

scripts.text:
[Tasty]
Ugh! Now, wait. What is that? Tch, the intruder?
scripts.translation:
[美味]
呃！等等，那是什麼？嘖，是入侵者嗎？

scripts.text:
[Tasty]
That's right! That's right! Oh, what should I do? What do I do, What do I do? Security? Oh, yeah. I was told to call security.
scripts.translation:
[美味]
沒錯！就是入侵者！怎麼辦？我該怎麼辦？保安？對了，有人叫我去找保安！

scripts.text:
[Tasty]
What? It's not working! When did it break down? Oh, what do I do?
scripts.translation:
[美味]
什麼？怎麼不管用！什麼時候壞掉的？我該怎麼辦？

scripts.text:
[Tasty]
Yeah! Mochi! I'll give you a piece of Mochi, so why don't we go somewhere else? You like mochi, don't you?
scripts.translation:
[美味]
對了！麻糬！我給你一塊麻糬，我們換個地方好不好？你喜歡麻糬吧？

scripts.text:
[Tasty]
Oh, it's not mochi? Aren't you the guy I met before? Then, meat? Do you like meat? You like meat, don't you? I've never seen anyone who doesn't like meat. I'll give you all the meat I have.
scripts.translation:
[美味]
咦，不是麻糬？你不是我之前遇到的那個人嗎？那肉呢？你喜歡肉吧？我還沒見過不喜歡肉的人呢。我把身上的肉全給你。

scripts.text:
[Tasty]
Strange? It's not meat? Then what can I get you? Do you want to go back?
scripts.translation:
[美味]
奇怪，不是肉？那我還能給你什麼？你想回去嗎？

scripts.text:
[Tasty]
Oh, what should I do? I was told not to run to the intruders. Are you here to ^0000CDtake my parts^000000? Is this the end of me?
scripts.translation:
[美味]
怎麼辦？有人叫我別靠近入侵者。你是來^0000CD拆我的零件^000000的嗎？我就要完蛋了嗎？

scripts.text: I'm not that kind of person.
scripts.translation: 我不是那種人。

scripts.text:
[Tasty]
You're not that kind of person...? Then, what kind of person are you?
scripts.translation:
[美味]
你不是那種人......？那你是哪種人？

scripts.text:
[Tasty]
Hold on...? You're right? You're not drooling, and your eyes are normal. Are you not an ^0000CDintruder^000000?
scripts.translation:
[美味]
等等......你說得對。你沒流口水，眼神也很正常。你不是^0000CD入侵者^000000嗎？

scripts.text: I'm a guest of the mansion, but...
scripts.translation: 我是宅邸的客人，不過......

scripts.text:
[Tasty]
What? A guest? Oh wait. I'll check...
scripts.translation:
[美味]
什麼？客人？等等，我查檢視......

scripts.text:
[Tasty]
It's real? But... You're a first time guest? New guest? Finally? Oh, I'm sorry for mistaking you as an intruder.
scripts.translation:
[美味]
真的？不過......你是第一次來的新客人？終於有新客人了？哎呀，抱歉把你錯認成入侵者。

scripts.text:
[Tasty]
I thought you were one of the intruder.
Somehow, everyone said they were running away, it's because of you, the new guests, right?
scripts.translation:
[美味]
我還以為你是入侵者之一。大家不知為何都說他們在逃跑，是因為你這個新客人嗎？

scripts.text:
[Tasty]
What's your relationship with the intruder? Are we natural enemies? Which way is above the pyramid? The intruders is running away, so it's your fault?
scripts.translation:
[美味]
你和入侵者是什麼關係？我們是天敵嗎？金字塔的上面是哪邊？入侵者在逃跑，所以是你的錯嗎？

scripts.text: It's not like that.
scripts.translation: 不是這樣的。

scripts.text:
[Tasty]
Oh, really? I didn't know because it's been so long since I saw a human being.
So why didn't I recognize a guest? All new guests would have been shared to us.
scripts.translation:
[美味]
真的嗎？我很久沒見過人類了，難怪不知道。
可是新客人的資訊都會同步給我們，我怎麼沒認出你呢？

scripts.text: The repeater is broken, so...
scripts.translation: 中繼器壞了，所以......

scripts.text:
[Tasty]
Oh, no wonder! The network stopped working suddenly. The repeater is not functioning! Then why isn't Alpha coming?
scripts.translation:
[美味]
難怪！網路突然斷了，原來是中繼器故障！那阿爾法怎麼還沒來？

scripts.text: Alpha is busy right now.
scripts.translation: 阿爾法現在很忙。

scripts.text:
[Tasty]
Alpha is too busy to come? No way. Oh, were you trying to help me voluntarily? What an unusual guest. Come to think of it, there was a^0000CDcustomer like that before^000000.
scripts.translation:
[美味]
阿爾法忙得來不了？怎麼會。哦，你是自願來幫我的？真是少見的客人。說起來，以前也有過^0000CD這樣的客人^000000。

scripts.text:
[Tasty]
I'm sorry.
The guest who visited the mansion showed interest in the mansion and us automatic dolls, but there were no guests who helped us around the mansion.
scripts.translation:
[美味]
抱歉。以前來宅邸的客人雖然對宅邸和我們自動人偶很感興趣，卻沒人幫忙處理宅邸裡的事。

scripts.text:
[Tasty]
Anyway, If we have a lot of guests, they'll be coming to eat soon. I've got to prepare. It's been a long time since I've had guests.
scripts.translation:
[美味]
總之來了這麼多客人，他們很快就會來吃飯。我得去準備了，好久沒招待客人了。

scripts.text:
[Tasty]
I haven't had any guests in the restaurant for a long time. I had no customer when I was cooking. The intruders... when they got here. My eyes change and I took them away. They were not guests.
scripts.translation:
[美味]
餐廳已經很久沒有客人了。以前我做飯時總是沒有顧客。入侵者......他們一闖進來，我的眼睛就變了，於是把他們帶走了。他們不是客人。

scripts.text:
[Tasty]
The invaders didn't last long, but they threw the mansion into chaos in that brief moment. They took the machines in the mansion, the automatic dools, everything that seemed useful to them were removed out of place.
scripts.translation:
[美味]
入侵者沒待多久，卻在短短時間裡把宅邸攪得一團亂。他們把機器、自動人偶，還有所有看起來有用的東西都拆走了。

scripts.text:
[Tasty]
That repeater over there must have a ^0000CDbroken communication chip too^000000?
scripts.translation:
[美味]
那邊的中繼器通訊晶片也^0000CD壞掉了^000000嗎？

scripts.text:
[Tasty]
Damn humans. Most of them seems to have run away by now, but there are still some left. I've seen them here a few times. They're after the food.
scripts.translation:
[美味]
可惡的人類。大多數好像已經逃走了，不過還剩一些。我見過他們幾次，他們是衝著食物來的。

scripts.text:
[Tasty]
Again, I'm sorry.
Now that I see it, I don't know why I mistaken you as an intruder. You're different.
scripts.translation:
[美味]
再次向你道歉。現在看清楚了，我也不明白剛才為什麼把你當成入侵者。你和他們不一樣。

scripts.text:
[Tasty]
Anyway, I have to fix the repeater. Let me see...
scripts.translation:
[美味]
總之，我得修好中繼器。讓我看看......

scripts.text:
[Tasty]
Well... the communication chip was ripped off! I'll have to put it in. Where should we get it right now? I have to greet guests?
scripts.translation:
[美味]
糟了，通訊晶片被扯掉了！得裝一塊新的。現在該去哪裡找呢？可是我還得招待客人！

scripts.text:
[Tasty]
Ugh- There's another broken one over there.
scripts.translation:
[美味]
唉......那邊還有一個壞掉的。

scripts.text:
[Tasty]
{0}. Can you catch that? Can you do it?
scripts.translation:
[美味]
{0}，你能抓住那個嗎？能做到嗎？

scripts.text: A broken automatic doll?
scripts.translation: 壞掉的自動人偶？

scripts.text:
[Tasty]
Uh. All communication chips are standard, so if they're replaced with a new one. I think it'll return back to normal.
scripts.translation:
[美味]
嗯，所有通訊晶片都是通用規格。換上一塊新的，我想它就能恢復正常。

scripts.text: Uh...

[Tasty]
Why do you look like that? Is it because you're reluctant to hurt an automatic doll in front of another one? Don't worry about that.
scripts.translation:
[美味]
你怎麼這副表情？是不想當著另一臺自動人偶的面傷害它嗎？別擔心。

scripts.text:
[Tasty]
We need to repair it anyway, but we need to capture it first.
You can think of it as saving the trouble for us automatic dolls.
scripts.translation:
[美味]
反正我們也得修好它，只是得先抓住它。
就當是在幫我們自動人偶省點力氣吧。

scripts.text:
[Tasty]
If you leave it alone, it will wander around the mansion and destroy it, so you'll have to deal with it quickly as you can.
It's better to capture it, then take out the chip and use it to fix the repeater.
scripts.translation:
[美味]
放任不管的話，它會在宅邸裡亂跑並破壞東西，所以得儘快處理。
最好先抓住它，再取出晶片修好中繼器。

scripts.text:
[Tasty]
Everyone has been doing that ever since the intruders showed up. Even if {0} doesn't do it, it's all up to us automatic dolls.
It's nice to work a little bit.
scripts.translation:
[美味]
入侵者來之後，我們一直在處理這些事。就算{0}不幫忙，也只能靠我們自動人偶自己來。能做點事也挺好的。

scripts.text:
[Tasty]
Please take care of the Broken Beta and bring ^0000CD1 Automatic Doll Communication Chip^000000.
scripts.translation:
[美味]
請處理故障貝塔，並帶回^0000CD1個自動人偶通訊晶片^000000。

scripts.text:
[Tasty]
What about the communication chip?
scripts.translation:
[美味]
通訊晶片呢？

scripts.text:
[Tasty]
You haven't yet? Are you reluctant to hurt an automatic doll? Don't worry about it. I will do it later on anyway.
scripts.translation:
[美味]
還沒找到嗎？是不忍心傷害自動人偶嗎？別擔心，反正我之後也會處理。

scripts.text:
[Tasty]
I'll take care of the broken automatic dolls, just bring ^0000CD1 Automatic Doll Communication Chip^000000.
scripts.translation:
[美味]
故障自動人偶交給我處理，你只要帶回^0000CD1個自動人偶通訊晶片^000000就行。

scripts.text:
[Tasty]
Did you bring it? Give it to me. I'll fix it. Thank you very much for bringing it.
scripts.translation:
[美味]
帶回來了嗎？交給我吧，我來修。非常感謝你把它帶回來。

scripts.text:
[Tasty]
By the way, is that the only broken repeater?
scripts.translation:
[美味]
對了，壞掉的中繼器只有這一個嗎？

scripts.text: The pavilion and the garden...
scripts.translation: 涼亭和花園......

scripts.text:
[Tasty]
Oh, really? Then go ahead to the <NAVI>[pavilion]<INFO>ba_maison,334,143,0,0,0</INFO></NAVI> first. It's the closest one here. Just follow this road over here.
scripts.translation:
[美味]
這樣啊，那先去<NAVI>[涼亭]<INFO>ba_maison,334,143,0,0,0</INFO></NAVI>吧，那裡最近。沿著這條路走就行。

scripts.text:
[Tasty]
Don't touch the broken repeater carelessly. Tell the nearby automatic dolls over there and they'll take care of it.
scripts.translation:
[美味]
別隨便碰壞掉的中繼器。告訴附近的自動人偶，它們會處理的。

scripts.text:
[Tasty]
Do you happen to have a Barmeal Ticket? It's use to eat at the restaurant. I'll give you this, so come and eat later! I'll prepare a good food for you! As thanks!
scripts.translation:
[美味]
你有餐券嗎？可以在餐廳用。我把這張給你，之後來吃飯吧！我會準備好吃的，感謝你幫忙！

scripts.text:
[Tasty]
Go ahead to the <NAVI>[pavilion]<INFO>ba_maison,334,143,0,0,0</INFO></NAVI> first. It's the closest one here. Just follow this road over here.
scripts.translation:
[美味]
先去<NAVI>[涼亭]<INFO>ba_maison,334,143,0,0,0</INFO></NAVI>吧，那裡最近。沿著這條路走就行。

scripts.text:
[Tasty]
Don't touch the broken repeater carelessly. Tell the nearby automatic dolls over there and they'll take care of it.
scripts.translation:
[美味]
別隨便碰壞掉的中繼器。告訴附近的自動人偶，它們會處理的。

scripts.text:
[Tasty]
What should I make today... What should I do to make it taste good?
scripts.translation:
[美味]
今天做什麼好呢......怎樣才能做得更好吃呢？

scripts.text:
^008800Wait a sec!!
You cannot receive any more items because you're carrying too many items. Please try again after you lighten up.^000000
scripts.translation:
^008800等一下！！
你帶的東西太多，無法再領取物品。減輕負重後再試。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
There's no one here...? What should I do with this? Is the automatic doll communication chip broken again...?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這裡沒人......這東西該怎麼辦？自動人偶的通訊晶片又壞了嗎......？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What if I open this...?

[{0}]
Argh!!!! My hand!!

[Worry]
This...! What a mess! Here we go again! It wants to fight.
scripts.translation:
[憂心]
這......真是一團糟！又來了！它又想打架。

scripts.text:
[Worry]
Get out of my head right now!
scripts.translation:
[憂心]
立刻從我腦子裡滾出去！

scripts.text: Over there...

[Worry]
Are you trying to control me?
scripts.translation:
[憂心]
你想控制我嗎？

scripts.text:
[Worry]
This little thing! I'll dispose of it!
scripts.translation:
[憂心]
這小東西！我這就把它處理掉！

scripts.text:
[Worry]
Are you trying to take over me?? Just try!!
scripts.translation:
[憂心]
你想佔據我的身體？！儘管試試！！

scripts.text: What should I do? Should I just go?
scripts.translation: 我該怎麼辦？就這麼走嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kimchi]
Phew- Here you are. Why do you keep escaping? Calm down for a bit.
scripts.translation:
[泡菜]
呼——你來了。你怎麼老是逃跑？先冷靜一下。

scripts.text:
[Kimchi]
Anyway, who...? An intruder? ...Is it not?
scripts.translation:
[泡菜]
對了，你是誰......？是入侵者嗎？......好像不是？

scripts.text:
[Kimchi]
Oh, you're a guest, aren't you? Those who come and go in front of the pavilion are also guests.
scripts.translation:
[泡菜]
哦，你是客人吧？在涼亭前來來往往的那些人也都是客人。

scripts.text:
[Kimchi]
But that's weird. If you're a guest, I would recognize you in an instance.
You are not an unregistered guest, you're a regular guest here.
scripts.translation:
[泡菜]
不過有點奇怪。客人的話，我應該一眼就認出來才對。
你不是沒登記的陌生客人，而是這裡的常客呢。

scripts.text: They can't share it because of the repeater.
scripts.translation: 因為中繼器壞了，名單沒法同步。

scripts.text:
[Kimchi]
Oh, it's because of that! Everytime time I find something broken, I'll repair it, but as you can see, even if I take my eyes out for a moment, Wary comes out and break it like this.
scripts.translation:
[泡菜]
哦，原來是這樣！每次發現東西壞了，我都會修好。可就像你看到的，只要我稍微移開視線，瓦里就會出來把它弄壞。

scripts.text:
[Kimchi]
Oh, did our hawk bit you? It's been going on since he was attacked by the ^0000CDintruders^000000. I already fixed it before, but Wary always come out and does this...
scripts.translation:
[泡菜]
哦，是我們的鷹咬了你嗎？它被^0000CD入侵者^000000襲擊後就一直這樣。我之前修好過，可瓦里總會跑出來把它弄壞......

scripts.text:
[Kimchi]
There are a lot of dolls that became like this.
They will return to normal if you fix it, but there are so many dolls that we are a hard time fixing all of them.
scripts.translation:
[泡菜]
有很多自動人偶都變成這樣了。修好後就會恢復正常，可數量實在太多，我們忙不過來。

scripts.text:
[Kimchi]
I heard the hawks wander around the mansion and ruin it.
scripts.translation:
[泡菜]
聽說那些鷹在宅邸裡到處亂跑，破壞東西。

scripts.text:
[Kimchi]
I'm sorry to interrupt you at your break. Please enjoy this area of the Varmundt's mansion to your hearts content.
scripts.translation:
[泡菜]
抱歉打擾你休息了。請盡情享受瓦爾蒙特宅邸這一帶吧。

scripts.text:
[Worry]
How can this thing be this lively.
scripts.translation:
[憂心]
這小東西怎麼這麼有精神？

scripts.text:
[Worry]
You, are you going to get out of my head or not? If you won't then I'll go out!
scripts.translation:
[憂心]
喂，你到底要不要從我腦子裡出去？你不出去的話，我可要出去了！

scripts.text:
[Kimchi]
Hey, hey. Why are you opening the repeater?
scripts.translation:
[泡菜]
等等，你為什麼要開啟中繼器？

scripts.text: Oh, you need to fix it quickly.
scripts.translation: 哦，你得趕快把它修好。

scripts.text:
[Worry]
What the hell are you? Are you pitying me?
scripts.translation:
[憂心]
你到底是什麼東西？是在可憐我嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kimchi]
Hey, this person is not an intruder. It's our guest. Let them enjoy here in the mansion.
scripts.translation:
[泡菜]
等等，這位不是入侵者，是我們的客人。讓他在宅邸裡好好參觀吧。

scripts.text:
[Kimchi]
I'll fix the repeater quickly. Wary will surely come out and destroy it, but don't worry we can fix it again.
scripts.translation:
[泡菜]
我馬上修好中繼器。瓦里肯定還會出來把它弄壞，不過別擔心，我們還能再修。

scripts.text:
[Kimchi]
Thank you for letting me know in person. Here, atleast, take this. Are there any other places where it doesn't work? I don't think there's only one or two places.
scripts.translation:
[泡菜]
謝謝你親自告訴我。來，至少請收下這個。還有別的地方也壞了嗎？我覺得故障應該不止一兩處。

scripts.text: The garden in front of the mansion.
scripts.translation: 宅邸前面的花園。

scripts.text:
[Kimchi]
Oh, it's not working there either.
Go up from this road and turn left to go to the <NAVI>[central garden]<INFO>ba_maison,245,206,0,0,0</INFO></NAVI>.
scripts.translation:
[泡菜]
那裡也壞了嗎？
沿這條路往上走再左轉，就能到<NAVI>[中央花園]<INFO>ba_maison,245,206,0,0,0</INFO></NAVI>。

scripts.text:
[Kimchi]
Come on, Warry. Let's go back.
scripts.translation:
[泡菜]
好了，瓦里，我們回去吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The doll told me to go up from this road and turn left to go to the <NAVI>[central garden]<INFO>ba_maison,245,206,0,0,0</INFO></NAVI>.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那個人偶讓我沿這條路往上走，再左轉前往<NAVI>[中央花園]<INFO>ba_maison,245,206,0,0,0</INFO></NAVI>。

scripts.text:
[Gabriel]
If this is the last one, please report back to <NAVI>[Alpha]<INFO>ba_maison,74,150,0,0,0</INFO></NAVI>.
scripts.translation:
[加布裡埃爾]
如果這是最後一臺，請向<NAVI>[阿爾法]<INFO>ba_maison,74,150,0,0,0</INFO></NAVI>彙報。

scripts.text:
[Gabriel]
May I help you?
This place is accessible only to authorized personnels.
Please return to the entrance.
scripts.translation:
[加布裡埃爾]
有什麼事嗎？
此處僅限獲准人員進入。
請返回入口。

scripts.text:
The number of items in your possession is too high, so you cannot proceed with the conversation.
Please clean up your inventory and try again.
scripts.translation:
你攜帶的物品太多，無法繼續交談。
請整理物品欄後再試。

scripts.text:
[Gabriel]
Hello, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[加布裡埃爾]
你好，冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Gabriel]
Don't come any closer.
This place is accessible only to authorized personnels.
scripts.translation:
[加布裡埃爾]
別再靠近。
此處僅限獲准人員進入。

scripts.text: Oh, I am...

[Gabriel]
I'm not concern about that. I don't need to know anything about you. This place is restricted. Raise your hands and don't come any closer.
scripts.translation:
[加布裡埃爾]
我不在乎你是誰，也不需要知道你的事。這裡是管制區域。舉起手，別再靠近。

scripts.text:
[Gabriel]
Don't even think about using weapons, I'm way faster than you are. Where did you come from?
scripts.translation:
[加布裡埃爾]
別想動武，我比你快得多。你是從哪裡來的？

scripts.text: The sewer, but I...
scripts.translation: 下水道，不過......

scripts.text:
[Gabriel]
So you came from the sewers, huh. Then stand still until I hand you over to the security.
scripts.translation:
[加布裡埃爾]
原來你是從下水道來的。站在那兒別動，我要把你交給保安。

scripts.text: I'm a guest at the mansion.
scripts.translation: 我是宅邸的客人。

scripts.text:
[Gabriel]
A guest? If you are one I would have known.
scripts.translation:
[加布裡埃爾]
客人？如果你是客人，我應該早就知道了。

scripts.text:
[Gabriel]
I will check it for a moment. Don't move from your spot.
scripts.translation:
[加布裡埃爾]
我查一下。待在原地別動。

scripts.text:
[Gabriel]
Oh, you're a real guest aren't you? You're a special guest who has permission to access all areas... I apologize for my mistake. Please excuse me.
scripts.translation:
[加布裡埃爾]
哦，您真的是客人。還是獲准進入所有區域的貴賓......我弄錯了，實在抱歉，請原諒。

scripts.text: I can't believe it. You suddenly attacked me.
scripts.translation: 真不敢相信，你剛才突然襲擊了我。

scripts.text:
[Gabriel]
Attack? Did I attack? I only responded according to the intruder response manual. Oh, did you felt like you were attacked?
scripts.translation:
[加布裡埃爾]
襲擊？我有襲擊你嗎？我只是按照入侵者應對手冊採取行動。哦，你覺得自己被襲擊了嗎？

scripts.text: No...

[Gabriel]
Once again, I apologize for my mistake.
Recently, we guards are more suspicious and sharper because of the intruders. Also, among the them there is a man with a low profile that appeared and resisted strongly.
scripts.translation:
[加布裡埃爾]
再次為我的失誤向您道歉。
最近因為入侵者的事，我們守衛都格外警惕。入侵者中還有個行蹤隱秘的男人，出現後進行了激烈抵抗。

scripts.text:
[Gabriel]
By the way, how were you able to get permission to access all areas? Normally, ordinary guests can only use non-restricted areas.
scripts.translation:
[加布裡埃爾]
對了，您是怎麼獲准進入所有區域的？通常普通訪客只能進入非管制區域。

scripts.text:
[Gabriel]
If you were such a distinguished guest, I should have received your information much earlier.
scripts.translation:
[加布裡埃爾]
如果您是貴賓，我理應早就收到您的資料。

scripts.text: It's because of the repeater.
scripts.translation: 因為中繼器出了故障。

scripts.text:
[Gabriel]
The repeater? The repeater here is working fine...
scripts.translation:
[加布裡埃爾]
中繼器？這裡的中繼器運作正常......

scripts.text:
[Gabriel]
Wait, this isn't a signal problem, suddenly there's a ^0000CDhacking channel^000000 jamming it... right?
scripts.translation:
[加布裡埃爾]
等等，這不是訊號問題，而是有人突然用^0000CD駭客頻道^000000干擾了訊號，對吧？

scripts.text: Hacking?
scripts.translation: 駭客？

scripts.text:
[Gabriel]
Knowing that the automatic dolls in the mansion send and receive signals throught the repeater. Sometimes, people ^0000CDhack the repeater^000000 to try to control the automatic dolls or to keep track of what's happening inside the mansion.
scripts.translation:
[加布裡埃爾]
宅邸裡的自動人偶通過中繼器收發訊號。有人會^0000CD入侵中繼器^000000，試圖控制自動人偶，或監視宅邸內的情況。

scripts.text:
[Gabriel]
There are still intruders left inside the mansion.
I must search thoroughly.
scripts.translation:
[加布裡埃爾]
宅邸裡還有入侵者。
我必須徹底搜查一遍。

scripts.text:
[Gabriel]
Previously, the intruders were alerted because of a guest who wandered around the mansion, thinking there were no such guest int the mansion.
scripts.translation:
[加布裡埃爾]
之前有位訪客以為宅邸裡沒有其他客人，便在裡面四處走動，結果驚動了入侵者。

scripts.text:
[Gabriel]
But that doesn't change the fact that they're intruders. Unlike the previous guest who were just curious, they infiltrated the premises and commited all kinds of violence in the mansion. Don't you think they're like a thief?
scripts.translation:
[加布裡埃爾]
但他們仍然是入侵者。之前那位訪客只是好奇，他們卻潛入管制區域，在宅邸裡大肆施暴。你不覺得他們就像盜賊嗎？

scripts.text:
[Gabriel]
{0}, If you don't want to be misunderstood by the other automatic dolls in the mansion, especially in the vicinity of restricted areas, you should identify yourself in advance.
scripts.translation:
[加布裡埃爾]
{0}，如果不想被宅邸裡的其他自動人偶誤會，尤其是在管制區域附近，就應該提前表明身份。

scripts.text: This is the last.
scripts.translation: 這是最後一個。

scripts.text:
[Gabriel]
Is that so? Then I'll have to hurry and the repeater, please excuse me.
Also, it's not much but please accept this as an apology.
scripts.translation:
[加布裡埃爾]
這樣啊？那我得趕緊去修中繼器了，先失陪。
這點小東西請收下，算是賠禮。

scripts.text:
[Gabriel]
If this is the last one, please report back to <NAVI>[Alpha]<INFO>ba_maison,74,150,0,0,0</INFO></NAVI>. Also... Welcome to the Varmundt's Mansion. If you need assistance, feel free to ask any automatic doll.
scripts.translation:
[加布裡埃爾]
如果這是最後一個，請向<NAVI>[阿爾法]<INFO>ba_maison,74,150,0,0,0</INFO></NAVI>彙報。
還有......歡迎來到瓦爾蒙特宅邸。需要幫忙的話，儘管問任何一臺自動人偶。

scripts.text:
[Gabriel]
If this is the last one, please report back to <NAVI>[Alpha]<INFO>ba_maison,74,150,0,0,0</INFO></NAVI>.
scripts.translation:
[加布裡埃爾]
如果這是最後一個，請向<NAVI>[阿爾法]<INFO>ba_maison,74,150,0,0,0</INFO></NAVI>彙報。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
Can you meet Alpha first and then come back here at the teahouse?
It seems that the first thing you need to do here is register yourself as a guest.
- A preceding quest still exist. -
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
能先去見阿爾法，再回茶室找我們嗎？
看來你得先登記成為宅邸訪客。
- 前置任務仍未完成。-

scripts.text:
[Tess]
Dien, please check the authenticity again.
This is a document that the goverment examined when the mercenaries stayed here at the Varmundt Mansion.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
迪恩，請再核實一下這份檔案。
這是政府在傭兵駐留瓦爾蒙特宅邸期間審查過的檔案。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
Well... even if tried to check the authenticity many times.
I'm not sure to what extent our cooperation will go.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
嗯......我已經反覆核實過了。
但我不確定我們的合作還能繼續到什麼程度。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
I'm a bit tired of saying the same thing over and over again.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
我已經厭倦一遍又一遍地說同樣的話了。

scripts.text: (The mood looks bad, Let's observe for now.)
scripts.translation: （氣氛不太對，先觀察一下。）

scripts.text:
[Tess]
If you take a look, you'll be to understand this evidence.
It's a proof that the goverment tried to talk to the mercenaries, but they didn't respond to it.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
你看看這份證據就明白了。
它證明政府曾試圖和傭兵交涉，但對方沒有回應。

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
That kind of talk never happened! Not a single soul from the government came to talk you know?
I already said no, how long will you keep asking me to find out the truth like a parrot?
scripts.translation:
[裡德什]
根本沒發生過那種事！政府根本沒人來找過我們，知道嗎？
我已經說過不是了，你還要像鸚鵡一樣追問多久？

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
It's the same when you brought us new documents, you're lying!
You've been lying to us several times already!
scripts.translation:
[裡德什]
你們拿新檔案來時也是這樣——你們在撒謊！
你們已經騙過我們好幾次了！

scripts.text:
[Tess]
Why would you think that we'll deliberately use false documents...!
Ah, {0}, since when have you been here? I've shown you a shameful side of me.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
我們為什麼要故意拿假檔案騙你們......！
啊，{0}，你什麼時候來的？讓你看到我這麼失態的一面了。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
I'm talking with the Rebellion <NAVI>[Elders]<INFO>ba_in01,203,103,0,0,0</INFO></NAVI>, but it's difficult to verify events that happened in the past...
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
我正在和反叛軍的<NAVI>[長老們]<INFO>ba_in01,203,103,0,0,0</INFO></NAVI>交談，但過去發生的事很難核實......

scripts.text:
[Tess]
I'm talking with the Rebellion <NAVI>[Elders]<INFO>ba_in01,203,103,0,0,0</INFO></NAVI>, but they're quite stubborn, perhaps because they're already seniors.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
我正在和反叛軍的<NAVI>[長老們]<INFO>ba_in01,203,103,0,0,0</INFO></NAVI>交談。不過他們都很固執，可能是因為資歷太深了。

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
Hey! Who are you calling seniors?
scripts.translation:
[裡德什]
喂！你說誰資歷深？

scripts.text:
[Tess]
Adventurer, please go to the managers of the mansion and find out what happened about the time when the mercenaries stayed here in Varmundt Mansion.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
冒險者，請去找宅邸管理員，調查傭兵駐留瓦爾蒙特宅邸期間究竟發生了什麼。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
If you're looking for a high-quality tea, this mansion is the place you're looking for.
The tea that I'm drinking in Einbech is not bad, but it's incomparable from the tea here.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
想喝好茶的話，這座宅邸最合適。
我在艾音貝赫喝的茶也不錯，但和這裡的茶沒法比。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
Hmm... Hey, gentleman from the government. Why do you keep asking for evidence when you don't believe what we're saying?
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
嗯......政府那位先生，既然你不相信我們的話，為什麼還一直追問證據？

scripts.text:
[Dien]
Let's bring a false documents to the mercenaries and ask them to prove every mistakes. We can't say anything about that.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
要不我們也拿偽造的檔案給傭兵，讓他們逐條證明哪裡有問題？對此我們還能說什麼？

scripts.text:
[Dien]
It's a waste of time.
I'd rather find another way, instead of wasting my time doing something contradictory.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
這樣只是在浪費時間。
我寧願另想辦法，也不想做這種自相矛盾的事。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
... what else could there be, other than to examine the records and write report.
Are you saying that you can't believe goverment-made report unconditionally?
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
......除了查閱記錄並寫報告，還能有什麼辦法？
你的意思是，政府寫的報告也不能無條件相信嗎？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
For a minute, could you listen to me?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
能聽我說幾句嗎？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
The question is, isn't it the credibility of the record itself?
No matter how much we use that record with mixed opinions, we won't be able to reach an agreement.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
問題在於記錄本身是否可信，對吧？
無論我們拿著這份各執一詞的記錄爭論多久，都不可能達成一致。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
...as a result, this happened.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
......所以才會變成這樣。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
So instead of relying on the government records, why don't we investigate the events that really happened here?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
所以，與其依賴政府記錄，不如直接調查這裡真正發生過的事？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
This place is the base of the Mercenaries War, If you investigate it with your own eyes, you might see things you haven't seen before.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
這裡曾是傭兵戰爭的據點。親自調查一番，或許能發現以前沒注意到的線索。

scripts.text: It's a good idea.
scripts.translation: 這是個好主意。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Well, who can remember exactly and vividly what occurred here?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
那麼，誰能清楚準確地回憶起這裡發生過什麼？

scripts.text: The Mansion Manager.
scripts.translation: 宅邸管理員。

scripts.text: The Cleaning Robots.
scripts.translation: 清潔機器人。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Adventurer, cleaning robots only response to what people say.
Ah, yes. The mansion managers would remember it!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
冒險者，清潔機器人只會複述別人說過的話。
啊，對了，宅邸管理員應該記得！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Yes, the Varmundt Mansion Managers! It's not human, but it probably a more neutral source of data.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
沒錯，瓦爾蒙特宅邸的管理員！雖然不是人類，但他們可能是更中立的資訊來源。

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
Lucky, Why aren't you listening to us and taking the government's side?
scripts.translation:
[裡德什]
拉基，你為什麼不聽我們說，反而站在政府那邊？

scripts.text:
[Tess]
It's a reasonable way. But who will witness it?
If I said I would, you wouldn't believe me.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
這辦法倒是合理。可由誰來作證？
就算我說自己可以，你們也不會信吧。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
If the government is asking me to believe the lies they've been building until now, then I can't cooperate with you.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
如果政府要我相信他們至今編造的謊言，那我沒法跟你們合作。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
How would you know if the government really tried to talk to the mercenaries, also how would you know that the mercenaries rejected it. You're just bringing us evidence that none of us have know.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
你們怎麼知道政府真的試圖和傭兵交涉，又怎麼知道傭兵拒絕了？你們拿來的證據，我們誰都沒見過。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
The elders wouldn't even go out to investigate themselves...,
Adventurer, you're the only one that the elders will believe.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
長老們甚至不願親自出去調查......
冒險者，長老們只會相信你。

scripts.text: I'll get their permission.
scripts.translation: 我會去徵得他們同意。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
I can believe what the adventurer done so far.
Will you listen to the managers for us, adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
到目前為止，我相信這位冒險者的所作所為。
冒險者，能替我們聽聽管理員怎麼說嗎？

scripts.text:
[Tess]
The existence of the adventurer is very important to both parties and invaluable in this place where various enemy forces are in motion.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
在各方勢力暗中行動的局勢下，冒險者對雙方都至關重要，在這裡更是無可替代。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
Adventurer, please go to the managers of the mansion and find out what happened about the time when the mercenaries stayed here in Varmundt Mansion.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
冒險者，請去找宅邸管理員，調查傭兵駐留瓦爾蒙特宅邸期間究竟發生了什麼。

scripts.text: Accept.
scripts.translation: 接受。

scripts.text: Refuse.
scripts.translation: 拒絕。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
Are you busy or it's just a bad time?
Don't you like what I asked you to do?
I can't force you to do it.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
你現在很忙，還是覺得時機不合適？
是不想做我拜託的事嗎？
我不會勉強你的。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
Thank you, adventurer. It seems you're left with the troublesome work again.
I look forward to the truth that is given by a neutral party.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
謝謝你，冒險者。看來麻煩的工作又落到你頭上了。
我期待聽到來自中立一方的真相。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
Thank you, adventurer. It seems you're left with the troublesome work again.
I look forward to the truth that is given by a neutral party.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
謝謝你，冒險者。看來麻煩的工作又落到你頭上了。
我期待聽到來自中立一方的真相。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
The managers knows the truth about the mercenary war.
They're all automatic dolls, they will have a vivid memory and they won't tell lies.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
宅邸管理員知道傭兵戰爭的真相。
他們都是自動人偶，記憶清晰，也不會說謊。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Please listen to the stories of those days, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
冒險者，請聽聽他們講述當年的事。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Have you heard enough from the managers?
Now, tell us about the facts that you've heard.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
你聽完管理員的說法了嗎？
現在把你瞭解到的情況告訴我們吧。

scripts.text: Tell the story of the mysterious body.
scripts.translation: 講述神秘屍體的事。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
There is a body suddenly, What do you mean?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
突然出現了一具屍體？這是什麼意思？

scripts.text:
[Dien]
It is said that the body that was found was not of the mercenaries, mansion's staff, or part of the corporate... Do you have any specific information?
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
據說那具屍體既不是傭兵，也不是宅邸員工，更不屬於公司的人......你掌握具體資訊嗎？

scripts.text: Hand over specific data.
scripts.translation: 提供具體資料。

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
This person doesn't really look like a mercenary. Why would a person like this be near Varmundt Mansion and be killed?
scripts.translation:
[裡德什]
這人看起來一點也不像傭兵。他為什麼會出現在瓦爾蒙特宅邸附近，還被殺了？

scripts.text:
[Tess]
Wait... Show me the data too.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
等等......把資料也給我看看。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
Is there something bothering you about this data?
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
這份資料有什麼地方讓你在意嗎？

scripts.text:
[Tess]
We know who this person is.
This person is one of the commissioner the government sent to the mercenaries for the negotiation.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
我們知道這個人的身份。
他是政府派去和傭兵談判的專員之一。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
It's said that the commissioner didn't come back after being sent, the commissioner was later presumed as a missing person.
But, later found dead in the Varmundt Mansion.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
據說這位專員奉命出發後便再沒回來，後來被認定為失蹤。
可他的屍體之後卻在瓦爾蒙特宅邸裡被發現了。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
So, you're saying... A government official who went to see the mercenaries, was killed before even meeting the mercenaries...
scripts.translation:
[新人]
所以你的意思是......政府官員去和傭兵會面，卻在見到傭兵之前就被殺害了......

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
This, who did such thing.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
到底是誰幹的？

scripts.text: The Enterprise.
scripts.translation: 企業。

scripts.text: The Government.
scripts.translation: 政府。

scripts.text: The Mercenaries.
scripts.translation: 傭兵。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
...There is no evidence, adventurer.
Your words gives me heartaches.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
......冒險者，你沒有證據。
你這麼說讓我很難受。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
We should talk more carefully.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我們得更謹慎地談這件事。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
Why would someone from the government kill the one they sent?
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
政府為什麼要殺自己派出去的人？

scripts.text:
[Tess]
Even if it's the government's opposition, it would have been difficult to commit murder without escaping the eyes of the mercenaries' and workers inside the Varmundt Mansion.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
就算是政府的反對派，也很難在傭兵和宅邸工作人員的眼皮底下殺人而不被發現。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
No, the mercenaries didn't even know it was a person from the government. Even the body was found late.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
不，傭兵甚至不知道那個人是政府派來的，而且屍體也是很久以後才被發現的。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
It wasn't the mercenaries.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
不是傭兵乾的。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
It would have been a difficult to avoid the eyes of the mercenaries' and workers in the Varmundt Mansion.
But, the mercenaries are not the culprit.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
要在傭兵和宅邸工作人員眼皮底下行兇而不被發現，確實很難。
不過兇手不是傭兵。

scripts.text: It's probably the mercenaries.
scripts.translation: 兇手大概是傭兵。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
Are you saying that we're lying? Even after listening to the managers?!
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
你是說我們在撒謊？你明明聽過管理員的證詞！

scripts.text: There must have been a traitor among the mercenaries.
scripts.translation: 傭兵中一定有內鬼。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
I'm sure there's enough evidence for you to say that.
Now, show us the evidence.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
你這麼說，想必有足夠的證據吧。
拿出來給我們看看。

scripts.text: H's suspicious behavior.
scripts.translation: H的可疑行徑。

scripts.text: Evidence of internal communication with the enterprise.
scripts.translation: 與企業內部通訊的證據。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
... But there's no evidence.
Right now, we can't rely on suspicions. We need proof, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
......可是沒有證據。
現在不能只靠懷疑，冒險者，我們需要確鑿證據。

scripts.text:
[Kaya Toss]
Thats... No, it's an envelope with the corporate's seal on it. It's badly crumpled. Where did you get this envelope? It's an item that's strictly forbidden to leak outside of Rekenber.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅·托斯]
這......不，這是蓋有公司印章的信封，已經被揉皺了。你從哪裡拿到的？這種東西嚴禁流出雷肯貝爾。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
Look at the contents of the envelope. That's what's important.
It's been a long time since I've last read, but I can read it perfectly, like it's a command book.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
信封裡的內容才是重點。
雖然很久沒讀過了，但我還記得一清二楚，就像讀過命令書一樣。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
I've asked someone to 'dispose' of the government personnel to prevent contact with the mercenaries... And I told him to break inside Varmundt Mansion and steal Varmundt's research data...
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
“為阻止政府人員與傭兵接觸，我已安排人手處理掉他們......並命令他潛入瓦爾蒙特宅邸，盜取瓦爾蒙特的研究資料......”

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
It's signed by the recipient, 'H. Luckenberg
It's a proof of the identity of the traitor that you mentioned.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
收件人簽了名：H. 盧肯貝格。
這就是你提到的內鬼身份的證據。

scripts.text:
[Kaya Toss]
..........

[Dien]
Corporate representative, You don't look so well.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
企業代表，您看起來臉色不太好。

scripts.text:
[Kaya Toss]
...I need some time, I have something that I want to check.
I'll get in touch with my secretary, please continue without me.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅·托斯]
......我需要一點時間，有件事想確認。
我會聯絡秘書。請你們先繼續。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Adventurer, Hey. Mr. Kaya was quite depressed. do you mind checking on Mr. Kaya?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
冒險者，等等。卡雅先生看起來很消沉，能去看看他嗎？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
It's always for something bad to happen at times like this...
I'd be reassured if could take a look at the <NAVI>[garden]<INFO>ba_maison,103,92,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
這種時候總覺得會出什麼岔子......
如果你能去<NAVI>[花園]<INFO>ba_maison,103,92,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>看看，我會比較放心。

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
I hope you're not thinking that we're stuck.
scripts.translation:
[裡德什]
希望你沒覺得我們束手無策。

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
Is there anything else suspicious about the mercenary?
scripts.translation:
[裡德什]
那個傭兵還有什麼可疑之處嗎？

scripts.text: Tell about various suspicious activities.
scripts.translation: 講述那些可疑行徑。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
From the mercenaries' perspective, he was suspicious.
However, it seems only a few people knew about it, and they believe each other, so the whole thing was not revealed.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
從傭兵的角度看，他確實很可疑。
但似乎只有少數人知道，而且他們彼此信任，所以這件事才一直沒被揭穿。

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
That's entirely the mercenary's mistake.
I would have known if I had a doubt and poked more into it.
scripts.translation:
[裡德什]
這完全是傭兵自己的疏忽。
要是我當時起了疑心並繼續追查，早就發現了。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
If we found out more about 'H. Luckenberg' at that time...
The Mercenary War might have ended differently.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
要是當時能查出“H. 盧肯貝格”更多的底細......
傭兵戰爭的結局或許會完全不同。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
I'm glad to know the truth.
The government offered an aid, but they were stopped by the companies...
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
知道真相真好。
政府本來提出了援助，卻被企業攔了下來......

scripts.text:
[Dien]
I apologize for not listening to your plead.
You weren't making false evidence. You just didn't know the truth.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
抱歉之前沒聽你的解釋。
你沒有偽造證據，只是當時不知道實情。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
I also want to apologize, for not believing your side of the story and forcing the evidence that we have brought.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
我也要道歉。我不該不相信你的說法，還逼你接受我們帶來的證據。

scripts.text:
[Kaya Toss]
..........
I'm sorry for leaving suddenly.

[Kaya Toss]
Something came in to my mind, and I checked it.
I'd like to tell you something what I have found out on my side.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅·托斯]
我突然想起一件事，就去查證了。
我想告訴你我這邊查到的情況。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
What is it?
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
什麼情況？

scripts.text:
[Kaya Toss]
On the corporate's employee directory... there is someone who has an exact match of H. Luckenberg's activity during that time.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅·托斯]
公司員工名冊裡有個人，他當時的行蹤與H. 盧肯貝格完全吻合。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
I see.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
原來如此。

scripts.text:
[Kaya Toss]
He was recorded as a returning employee from a long business trip during the mercenary war.
However, the place he went to was not documented.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅·托斯]
記錄顯示，他在傭兵戰爭期間結束長期出差返回了公司。
不過，出差地點沒有記載。

scripts.text:
[Kaya Toss]
My secretary, Grey, searched through an incomplete records and found this note among the remaining work log memos.
'As fast as possible (Traces of erased memo) lead them to the mansion'
scripts.translation:
[卡雅·托斯]
我的秘書格雷查閱了殘缺的記錄，在剩餘的工作日誌裡發現一條便箋：
“儘快（有被擦除的字跡）把他們引到宅邸。”

scripts.text:
[Kaya Toss]
The subject of the memo is vaguely written but it can be clearly understood.
That, he was in Varmundt Mansion...
scripts.translation:
[卡雅·托斯]
便箋裡沒有明確寫出物件，但意思很清楚。
他當時就在瓦爾蒙特宅邸......

scripts.text:
[Dien]
So that's what happened.
The government and mercenaries have been played by the companies again.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
原來是這樣。
政府和傭兵又一次被企業利用了。

scripts.text:
[Kaya Toss]
It's a shame...
scripts.translation:
[卡雅·托斯]
真遺憾......

scripts.text:
[Kaya Toss]
All contextual, and material evidence evidence leads to the corporate.
This is, really, a shame.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅·托斯]
所有背景資料和實物證據都指向企業。
這實在令人遺憾。

scripts.text:
[Kaya Toss]
I am sorry.
As the Vice President, I feel responsible for all of this.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅·托斯]
對不起。
作為副總裁，這一切我都有責任。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
Well... Mr. Corporate Representative, what's the difference between you feeling responsible at this point?
If you apologized, will it bring the dead back?
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
嗯......企業代表先生，現在才覺得自己有責任又有什麼用？道歉能讓死者復生嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kaya Toss]
I will take full responsibility for everything, starting by not forgetting the past.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅·托斯]
我會承擔全部責任，首先要做的就是不忘記過去。

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
The past? No. It's about what's happening now, the present time. Those Rebellion kids and those who are still sick at Cor are happening now.
Everything you say of the past continues to this day.
scripts.translation:
[裡德什]
過去？不，是現在，是眼下發生的事。反叛軍裡的那些年輕人，還有柯爾仍在生病的人，都是現在的事。
你所說的過去，直到今天仍在延續。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
What are going to do now? You can apologize as much as you want. But it's hard to change people's mind.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
你現在打算怎麼辦？道歉再多也改變不了人們的想法。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
Let's stop talking about this now. I don't want to talk to you anymore if you continue to repeat the words of taking responsibility without even saying what you're planning to do.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
別再說這件事了。如果你只會反覆說要承擔責任，卻不說打算怎麼做，我不想再談下去。

scripts.text:
[Kaya Toss]
But, Elder........
scripts.translation:
[卡雅·托斯]
可是，長老......

scripts.text:
[Cotnes]
When you talk proudly like that, it's better not to do it pitifully.
Hohoho, Then I'm off too.
scripts.translation:
[科特內斯]
既然說得那麼冠冕堂皇，就別擺出一副可憐相。
呵呵呵，我也先走了。

scripts.text:
[Kaya Toss]
Recently, I'm thinking for a lot of things.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅·托斯]
最近我想了很多事情。

scripts.text:
[Cotnes]
I don't have the luxury, to listen to your stories.
scripts.translation:
[科特內斯]
我可沒閒工夫聽你講這些。

scripts.text:
^008800Wait a sec!!
You cannot receive any more items because you're carrying too many items. Please try again after you lighten up.^000000
scripts.translation:
^008800等一下！！
你帶的東西太多，無法再領取物品。減輕負重後再試。^000000

scripts.text:
[???]
To think you're really going to take out the liver and gallbladder for everyone.
The corporate is ashamed of you.
scripts.translation:
[???]
沒想到你真打算為所有人捐出肝臟和膽囊。
企業真為你感到羞恥。

scripts.text:
[Kaya Toss]
?!?
scripts.translation:
[卡雅·托斯]
？！

scripts.text:
[Kaya Toss]
Who are you. Why are you hiding in a place like this?
scripts.translation:
[卡雅·托斯]
你是誰？為什麼躲在這種地方？

scripts.text:
[???]
Vice President, I'm with the Rekenber's Board. ...... You don't need to know my identity.
scripts.translation:
[???]
副總裁，我來自雷肯貝爾董事會。......我的身份你不必知道。

scripts.text:
[Kaya Toss]
You rude...! This is not a place for anyone to come and go. Why did you sneak and look for me?
scripts.translation:
[卡雅·托斯]
你太無禮了......！這裡不是誰都能隨意進出的地方。你為什麼偷偷跟蹤我？

scripts.text:
[???]
The corporate is worried about the Vice President's action. How long are you going to be swayed by their eloquence? What would you do if a representative of the corporate repeatedly acts againt the interest of the corporate?
scripts.translation:
[???]
企業很擔心副總裁的行動。你還要被他們的花言巧語矇騙多久？如果企業代表一再做出損害公司利益的事，你要怎麼辦？

scripts.text:
[Kaya Toss]
Act against the corporate's interest, I'm always working for the benefit of the corporate.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅·托斯]
損害企業利益？我一直都在為企業謀利。

scripts.text:
[???]
Let's pick one. Excessive promise of compensation for an accident, overestimation of corporate responsibility.
You're hurting not only the corporate's finances but also its reputation.
scripts.translation:
[???]
隨便舉個例子：對事故作出過度賠償承諾，或誇大企業應負的責任。
你不僅損害企業的財務，也損害了它的聲譽。

scripts.text:
[???]
Why would the corporate compensate for an accident caused by the Illusions?
Rather, it should be the corporate that should receive compensation.
scripts.translation:
[???]
幻影造成的事故，企業為什麼要賠償？
應該由企業向他們索賠才對。

scripts.text:
[Kaya Toss]
Is there a problem when I promised the welfare benefits of the corporate to those who we hired and working under the name of the corporate?
scripts.translation:
[卡雅·托斯]
我向受僱於企業、以企業名義工作的人承諾福利，這有什麼問題？

scripts.text:
[???]
You're giving too much benefits.
At this rate, more and more people will want to extort money from the corporate for various reasons.
scripts.translation:
[???]
你給的福利太多了。照這樣下去，越來越多人會找各種理由向企業敲詐。

scripts.text:
[Kaya Toss]
I don't think all of that is too much.
I'm just doing what we have to do.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅·托斯]
我不覺得那些福利過分。
我只是在做該做的事。

scripts.text:
[???]
Phew...... If I had been through with you, I wouldn't have come. That's it. I didn't come here to have a conversation anyway.
scripts.translation:
[???]
呼......要是能和你談妥，我也不會親自來了。就這樣吧，我本來就不是來跟你聊天的。

scripts.text:
[Kaya Toss]
What do you mean?
scripts.translation:
[卡雅·托斯]
你這是什麼意思？

scripts.text:
[???]
A conversation is meaningless. It's time for you to disappear from this place!
scripts.translation:
[???]
談話毫無意義。你該從這裡消失了！

scripts.text: It's dangerous!
scripts.translation: 小心！

scripts.text:
[Dien]
It's dangerous!
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
小心！

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
I've come here to see what's wrong, and looks like a rat appeared.
scripts.translation:
[裡德什]
我來看看出了什麼事，看來有隻老鼠冒出來了。

scripts.text:
[Cotnes]
Who are you! I'm not going to let you go!
scripts.translation:
[科特內斯]
你是誰！別想逃！

scripts.text:
[???]
Shit, were you caught?! By these uselessly sharp old people!
scripts.translation:
[???]
該死，被抓住了？！居然栽在這些敏銳得過頭的老傢伙手裡！

scripts.text:
[Kaya Toss]
Do, thank you for your help, Elders. It's... It's a job I've devoted my while life to. And the corporate sent an assassin to kill me.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅·托斯]
多謝長老們出手相助。這......這是我畢生投入的事業，沒想到企業竟派刺客來殺我。

scripts.text:
[Kaya Toss]
I won't lose though.
The only path for the corporate is clearing the past and improving the present.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅·托斯]
但我不會認輸。
企業唯一的出路，就是正視過去，改善現在。

scripts.text:
[Kaya Toss]
I won't lose though.
The only path for the corporate is clearing the past and improving the present.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅·托斯]
但我不會認輸。
企業唯一的出路，就是正視過去，改善現在。

scripts.text:
[Kaya Toss]
Understood. I'm going to contact the company and ask for an important person to talk more deeply with the government and the Rebellions.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅·托斯]
明白了。我會聯絡公司，請一位重要人士出面，與政府和反叛軍深入會談。

scripts.text:
[Kaya Toss]
We should investigate this incident properly and catch the culprit.
Thank you again for your cooperation.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅·托斯]
我們應該徹底調查此事，找出幕後黑手。
再次感謝各位配合。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
You must have been very surprised, but I gave my thanks to you for proceeding quickly.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
你一定嚇了一跳，不過還是謝謝你迅速採取了行動。

scripts.text:
[Kaya Toss]
Then let's return to the tea house. I also want to calm down a little.
Elders, will you come with me?
scripts.translation:
[卡雅·托斯]
那我們回茶室吧，我也想冷靜一下。
長老們，願意和我一起去嗎？

scripts.text:
[Dien]
I'd be happy to escort you.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
我很樂意陪您過去。

scripts.text:
[Kaya Toss]
I'd be grateful if you would come with us too, adventurer.
Let's have a tea together, while waiting for the important person to come.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅·托斯]
冒險者，也請你和我們一起去吧。
等那位重要人士來之前，我們一起喝杯茶。

scripts.text:
[Kaya Toss]
I'm here to think for a moment.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅·托斯]
我在這裡稍微想些事情。

scripts.text:
[Yunas]
Welcome, honored guest, I'm an automatic doll with an identifier called Yunas.
Of course, I'm standing here to assist any guests that needs it.
scripts.translation:
[尤納斯]
歡迎您，尊貴的客人。我是編號為尤納斯的自動人偶。
我在此處就是為了協助有需要的客人。

scripts.text: I want to ask about past records.
scripts.translation: 我想查詢過去的記錄。

scripts.text:
[Yunas]
What record would you like me to check?
scripts.translation:
[尤納斯]
您想查哪類記錄？

scripts.text: Any record of mercenaries is a bell.
scripts.translation: 任何一段傭兵記錄都可以。

scripts.text:
[Yunas]
I'll prepare the record. Please wait a moment.
scripts.translation:
[尤納斯]
我來調取記錄，請稍等。

scripts.text:
[Yunas]
As the guest requested. I'll deliver random selection of record about mercenaries in the database.
scripts.translation:
[尤納斯]
既然客人這樣要求，我會從資料庫中隨機選取一段傭兵記錄。

scripts.text:
[Mercenary]
How did we get here?
scripts.translation:
[傭兵]
我們是怎麼到這裡來的？

scripts.text:
[Mercenary]
A mansion... of someone you never knew.
I have never been in a mansion like this before.
scripts.translation:
[傭兵]
這是座陌生人的宅邸。
我從沒見過這樣的宅邸。

scripts.text:
[Mercenary]
What kind of person is Varmundt, who accepted us willingly?
scripts.translation:
[傭兵]
瓦爾蒙特究竟是什麼樣的人，為什麼願意收留我們？

scripts.text:
[Mercenary]
Oh, you should've asked who it is.
Aren't you the one who saved us when we thought we're all going to die?
scripts.translation:
[傭兵]
你應該問他是誰才對。
我們以為自己死定時，不就是他救了我們嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mercenary]
Yes, we're alive thanks to Mr. Varmundt and Mr. H
If Mr.H hadn't asked us to come here, we'd all be dead by now.
scripts.translation:
[傭兵]
是啊，多虧瓦爾蒙特先生和H先生，我們才能活下來。
要不是H先生讓我們來這裡，大家現在早就沒命了。

scripts.text:
[Mercenary]
Let's regain our strength here and prepare for the fight.
scripts.translation:
[傭兵]
我們先在這裡恢復體力，為接下來的戰鬥做準備。

scripts.text:
[Yunas]
Do you have any more records you'd want to take a look at?
scripts.translation:
[尤納斯]
還想再看其他記錄嗎？

scripts.text: I'm curious about the guy named Mr. H.
scripts.translation: 我想了解那個H先生。

scripts.text: No more.
scripts.translation: 不用了。

scripts.text:
[Yunas]
Thank you for reading the records!
If you need any more records, please do not hesitate to ask.
scripts.translation:
[尤納斯]
謝謝您查閱記錄！
還想看其他記錄的話，請隨時告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Mercenary]
... I think I've finally calm down.
Everyone was furious.
scripts.translation:
[傭兵]
......我想我總算冷靜下來了。
剛才大家都氣壞了。

scripts.text:
[Mercenary]
But it was something that had to be done.
People simply died like that, people... There was blood everywhere and their eyes turned over.
Now that I think about it, I deeply regret it.
scripts.translation:
[傭兵]
可當時確實不得不那麼做。
人就那樣死了......到處都是血，眼睛都翻白了。
現在回想起來，我真是後悔。

scripts.text:
[Mercenary]
We used the substitute plan and we took more casualty than we should have.
I should have stopped Mr. H.
Everyone started yelling and panicking that we had to get rid of them first...
scripts.translation:
[傭兵]
我們啟用了備用方案，結果傷亡比預期更慘重。
我本該阻止H先生。
大家都在喊、都慌了神，說必須先把他們解決掉......

scripts.text:
[Mercenary]
Neither Mr.H and we are not so bled up back then.
Don't blame Mr.H too much.
scripts.translation:
[傭兵]
當時H先生和我們都沒受太重的傷。
別太責怪H先生。

scripts.text:
[Mercenary]
Well, that's true... Let's stop talking about, dwelling on it will just be hard on us.
scripts.translation:
[傭兵]
嗯，說得也是......別再提了，繼續想下去只會更難受。

scripts.text:
[Yunas]
Do you have any more records you'd want to take a look at?
scripts.translation:
[尤納斯]
還想再看其他記錄嗎？

scripts.text: I'm done.
scripts.translation: 我看完了。

scripts.text:
[Yunas]
Thank you for reading the records!
If you need any more records, please do not hesitate to ask.
scripts.translation:
[尤納斯]
謝謝您查閱記錄！
還想看其他記錄的話，請隨時告訴我。

scripts.text: - I need to remember what I heard carefully. -
scripts.translation: - 得仔細記住剛才聽到的內容。-

scripts.text:
[Yunas]
Welcome to the Varmundt Mansion. The Varmundt Mansion provides various benefits such as medical services, shopping and entertainment, and leisure activities...
scripts.translation:
[尤納斯]
歡迎來到瓦爾蒙特宅邸。這裡提供醫療、購物、娛樂和休閒等各種服務......

scripts.text:
[Yunas]
Uh. Oops. This is not it. I have mistakenly told you the wrong thing.
Please disregard it...
scripts.translation:
[尤納斯]
呃，哎呀，說錯了。這不是我要說的內容。
請別放在心上......

scripts.text:
[Skippy]
Do you want any records from a guest from the past?
Do you have a specific record in mind?
scripts.translation:
[斯基皮]
您想檢視過去訪客的記錄嗎？
有指定要找的記錄嗎？

scripts.text: Any record of incidents and accidents.
scripts.translation: 任何事故或意外的記錄。

scripts.text:
[Skippy]
Let me check for a moment...
Record is randomly selected from the incedent and accident category.
scripts.translation:
[斯基皮]
請稍等......
我會從事故類別中隨機選取一條記錄。

scripts.text:
[Skippy]
Incident, record 5872, confirmed.
I'll play back the records of that time.
scripts.translation:
[斯基皮]
事故記錄5872，已確認。
現在為您播放當時的記錄。

scripts.text:
[Mercenary]
A body was found near the wall of the mansion.
scripts.translation:
[傭兵]
宅邸牆邊發現了一具屍體。

scripts.text:
[Mercenary]
What's that horrible story?
Whose body is it?
scripts.translation:
[傭兵]
這是什麼可怕的事？
那是誰的屍體？

scripts.text:
[Mercenary]
Well, no one knows. Even the managers doesn't know.
The body was neatly dressed, and doesn't look like a mercenary at all.
scripts.translation:
[傭兵]
不知道，連管理員也不清楚。
屍體穿著整齊，怎麼看都不像傭兵。

scripts.text:
[Mercenary]
Do you think they're already here?
But the corporate people aren't going to dress up and visit us.
scripts.translation:
[傭兵]
你覺得他們已經來了？
可企業的人不會打扮成那樣來拜訪我們吧。

scripts.text:
[Mercenary]
I know, it's just an apparition that's grumbling,
I hope it's not a big deal...
scripts.translation:
[傭兵]
我知道，那只是個喋喋不休的幽靈。
希望不是什麼大問題......

scripts.text:
[Skippy]
The record playback has finished.
Do you need any information about other records?
scripts.translation:
[斯基皮]
記錄播放完畢。
還需要查詢其他記錄嗎？

scripts.text: I need more information about the body.
scripts.translation: 我想了解屍體的更多資訊。

scripts.text:
[Skippy]
Please wait a moment, gender is female, name is unidentified and she was wearing a gray suit, but very disheveled with blood.
The cause of death was an attack from behind... then...
scripts.translation:
[斯基皮]
請稍等。死者為女性，姓名不明，身穿灰色套裝，衣著凌亂且沾滿鮮血。
死因是遭人從背後襲擊......然後......

scripts.text: - I received a records of an unknown body. -
scripts.translation: - 我拿到了一具身份不明屍體的記錄。-

scripts.text:
[Skippy]
Hello, there. Do you need a record of the past guests?
The guest list is recorded in a huge database.
scripts.translation:
[斯基皮]
您好，需要查詢過去訪客的記錄嗎？
訪客名單儲存在一個龐大的資料庫裡。

scripts.text:
[Adore]
Hello, guest. Can I help you?
scripts.translation:
[阿多爾]
您好，客人。有什麼需要我幫忙的嗎？

scripts.text: Records about the mercenaries in the past.
scripts.translation: 過去傭兵的記錄。

scripts.text:
[Adore]
There's a lot of record about past guests, what kind of records do you need?
scripts.translation:
[阿多爾]
過去訪客的記錄有很多。您想查哪一類？

scripts.text: About a mercenary named H.
scripts.translation: 一名叫H的傭兵。

scripts.text:
[Adore]
Searching, searching... Search complete. There are a very few records about Mr. H...
However, there are many records of what others said about Mr. H.
scripts.translation:
[阿多爾]
正在搜尋......搜尋完成。關於H先生的記錄很少......
不過，有很多其他人談到H先生的記錄。

scripts.text:
[Adore]
If you want to read about the record, I will prepare it for you.
scripts.translation:
[阿多爾]
您想看這些記錄的話，我可以為您調取。

scripts.text:
[Mercenary]
By the way, where's Mr. H?
I've been looking for him for a while, but...
scripts.translation:
[傭兵]
對了，H先生在哪兒？
我找了他一陣子，可是......

scripts.text:
[Mercenary]
It seems his away often.
I have to talk to him someday. What if the corporates suddenly comes in.
scripts.translation:
[傭兵]
他好像經常不在。我得找機會跟他談談，萬一企業的人突然找上門呢？

scripts.text:
[Mercenary]
Not long ago, I saw Mr. H talking with someone I don't know.
scripts.translation:
[傭兵]
不久前，我看到H先生在和一個陌生人說話。

scripts.text:
[Mercenary]
A person you don't know, where would you find a person a random person here?
scripts.translation:
[傭兵]
陌生人？這種地方哪來的陌生人？

scripts.text:
[Mercenary]
That's why it's weird. He was also thoroughly checking the perimeter, but I'm good at hiding.
scripts.translation:
[傭兵]
所以才奇怪啊。他還仔細檢視周圍，不過我很會藏身。

scripts.text:
[Mercenary]
What did they talk about?
scripts.translation:
[傭兵]
他們說了什麼？

scripts.text:
[Mercenary]
I didn't hear it because it was too far.
scripts.translation:
[傭兵]
距離太遠，我沒聽見。

scripts.text:
[Mercenary]
You didn't hide well, you were just far away!
Anyway, that's really suspicious. What the hell is going on?
..................
..................
scripts.translation:
[傭兵]
你根本沒藏好，只是離得遠而已！
總之這事很可疑。到底怎麼回事？
..................
..................

scripts.text:
[Adore]
Record out is complete.
Do you need more information about H.?
scripts.translation:
[阿多爾]
記錄已調取完畢。
還要查詢有關H先生的資訊嗎？

scripts.text: H's conversation with the stranger.
scripts.translation: H和陌生人的談話。

scripts.text:
[Adore]
Searching... no results found. We don't have any record of that information.
This record was recorded by a cleaning robot and the manager without ears.
scripts.translation:
[阿多爾]
正在搜尋......沒有結果。我們沒有這方面的記錄。
這段記錄由清潔機器人和一位無耳的管理員儲存。

scripts.text: The place where the conversation was recorded.
scripts.translation: 談話發生的地點。

scripts.text:
[Adore]
Searching... Through the records of the cleaning robot, I can guide you to the last recognized location at that record.
I will give you the coordinate. Please follow this <NAVI>[guide]<INFO>ba_maison,357,291,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>.
scripts.translation:
[阿多爾]
正在搜尋......根據清潔機器人的記錄，我可以帶您去這段記錄最後識別到的位置。
座標已為您標出，請跟隨<NAVI>[指引]<INFO>ba_maison,357,291,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>前往。

scripts.text:
[Adore]
Hello, there. How can I help you?
I am really glad to assist any guest.
scripts.translation:
[阿多爾]
您好，有什麼可以幫您？
能協助客人，我很高興。

scripts.text:
[Adore]
You should do anything to please me!
Yes, I am created that way.
scripts.translation:
[阿多爾]
你應該想盡辦法讓我開心！
沒錯，我就是為此而造的。

scripts.text: - Do you remember any of the guests' conversations? -
scripts.translation: - 你還記得訪客們說過什麼嗎？-

scripts.text:
[Nono]
You mean the old guests?
Of course I remember everything!
What story would you like to hear? I'll tell you all about it!
scripts.translation:
[諾諾]
您是說以前的客人？
我當然什麼都記得！
想聽什麼故事？我全都告訴您！

scripts.text:
[Nono]
I have searched the database for past guests' conversations, the records are selected randomly!
Here are the following results!
scripts.translation:
[諾諾]
我已經從資料庫裡檢索了過去訪客的談話記錄，以下內容是隨機選出的！
請看結果！

scripts.text: Someone's Travel.
scripts.translation: 某人的旅程。

scripts.text: Traces of Discovery.
scripts.translation: 發現的痕跡。

scripts.text: Goverment Criticism.
scripts.translation: 對政府的批評。

scripts.text:
[Nono]
I'll play the record!
scripts.translation:
[諾諾]
我來播放記錄！

scripts.text:
[Mercenary]
There is a mercenary who was almost thrown out while trying to go deep into the mansion. Who is it?
scripts.translation:
[傭兵]
有個傭兵試圖深入宅邸，差點被趕出去。你們猜是誰？

scripts.text:
[Mercenary]
I think it was Mr. H. Why would he do such a thing.
scripts.translation:
[傭兵]
我覺得是H先生。他為什麼要這麼做？

scripts.text:
[Mercenary]
Yeah. The supply that was provided to us are enough to get by already.
scripts.translation:
[傭兵]
是啊，我們得到的補給已經夠用了。

scripts.text:
[Mercenary]
Did H. needed more Barmeal Tickets?
Even if he didn't need it, I would still have shared it to him if he asked.
scripts.translation:
[傭兵]
H先生還需要餐券嗎？就算他用不上，只要開口，我也願意分給他。

scripts.text:
[Mercenary]
I'm suspicious of Mr. H. Don't you think he's only doing that stands out?
scripts.translation:
[傭兵]
我懷疑H先生。你不覺得他總是故意做些引人注目的事嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mercenary]
Come on, don't say that. We should trust each other.
scripts.translation:
[傭兵]
別這麼說，我們應該彼此信任。

scripts.text:
[Mercenary]
Another suspicious trace was found near the mansion.
This time, someone said it's the trace of a fierce battle, but none of us got hurt or went missing.
scripts.translation:
[傭兵]
宅邸附近又發現了可疑痕跡。
這次有人說那裡發生過激戰，可我們沒有人受傷或失蹤。

scripts.text:
[Mercenary]
I've heard it too. It must have been those corporate guys! We musn't stay here and clean up out there.
scripts.translation:
[傭兵]
我也聽說了！肯定是企業的人乾的！我們不能繼續待在這裡，得出去查清楚！

scripts.text:
[Mercenary]
Calm down. You don't even know what happened, do you?
No one was hurt but they found a lot of blood stains. The leaders are still investigating it.
scripts.translation:
[傭兵]
冷靜點，你連發生了什麼都不知道吧？沒人受傷，但發現了很多血跡。首領們還在調查。

scripts.text:
[Mercenary]
How can we not know anything when there is a lot of mess happening out there. I'm so frustrating, very frustrating!!
scripts.translation:
[傭兵]
外面出了這麼多亂子，我們怎麼可能什麼都不知道？真讓人惱火，太惱火了！！

scripts.text:
[Mercenary]
I thought that the goverment will mediate in the case of an incident, but it's as if we didn't exist in the goverment's eyes.
scripts.translation:
[傭兵]
我以為出了事政府會出面調停，可在政府眼裡，我們就像不存在一樣。

scripts.text:
[Mercenary]
There's no movement at all, let alone mediation.
Are we not citizens? How could they do this!
scripts.translation:
[傭兵]
別說調停了，政府一點動靜都沒有。
我們就不是公民嗎？他們怎麼能這樣！

scripts.text:
[Mercenary]
There's been a lot of bloodshed, and such big commotions.
If the government doesn't come forward at times like this, someone has to step up and advance the government forward.
scripts.translation:
[傭兵]
已經流了這麼多血，鬧出這麼大亂子。
這種時候政府不站出來，就得有人推動他們採取行動。

scripts.text:
[Mercenary]
But no one's stepping up. The government is not like a real government, it's not moving forward at all.
scripts.translation:
[傭兵]
可沒人站出來。這個政府根本不像個政府，什麼進展都沒有。

scripts.text:
[Nono]
My name is Nono, and I want to fly high in the sky.
I was named Nono because I want to be called that way.
scripts.translation:
[諾諾]
我叫諾諾，想飛到高高的天空中。
因為我想被這樣稱呼，所以取名叫諾諾。

scripts.text: - A little away from the reception area, a cleaning robot lies discharged in the shadow. It seems like it's been here for a very long time. -
scripts.translation: - 接待區不遠處的陰影裡躺著一臺沒電的清潔機器人。它似乎已經停在這裡很久了。-

scripts.text: - I turned it upside down and it's stopped because of a little paper envelope stucked in it. -
scripts.translation: - 你把它翻過來，發現一個小紙信封卡在裡面，導致機器人停了下來。-

scripts.text: - Is this a Rekenber's pattern on the envelope? Why are these things here?
scripts.translation: - 信封上有雷肯貝爾的標誌嗎？這種東西為什麼會在這裡？-

scripts.text: - Carefully, I took out the envelope to not tear it. -
scripts.translation: - 你小心地取出信封，避免把它撕破。-

scripts.text:
^008800Wait a sec!!
You cannot receive any more items because you're carrying too many items. Please try again after you lighten up.^000000
scripts.translation:
^008800等一下！！
你攜帶的物品太多，無法再領取物品。減輕負重後再試。^000000

scripts.text: The body of Manager Beta is hidden under the landscapes.
scripts.translation: 管理員貝塔的遺體被藏在佈景下面。

scripts.text:
I've recovered the core.
I'll let Alpha know later so she can retrieve the doll's body.
Let's look for more.
scripts.translation:
核心已經回收。
稍後通知阿爾法來取回人偶的軀體吧。
繼續找找看。

scripts.text:
I've recovered the core.
I'll let Alpha know later so she can retrieve the doll's body.
I've recovered enough cores.
scripts.translation:
核心已經回收。
稍後通知阿爾法來取回人偶的軀體吧。
回收的核心已經夠多了。

scripts.text:
You cannot proceed with the quest because you have too many items in your possession.
Please clean up your inventory and try again.
scripts.translation:
你攜帶的物品太多，無法繼續任務。
請整理物品欄後再試。

scripts.text:
[Elena Bolkova]
Hey, adventurer, this way. Did you get any results?
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·博爾科娃]
嘿，冒險者，這邊。有發現嗎？

scripts.text: Why, Elena?
scripts.translation: 怎麼了，埃琳娜？

scripts.text:
[Elena Bolkova]
Lucky asked me a favor.
Elyumina seems to have been attacked again.
I just happen to be nearby at the time and somehow pull her out from that predicament.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·博爾科娃]
拉基拜託我幫個忙。
艾露米娜好像又遇襲了。
我正好在附近，就把她救了出來。

scripts.text: Show her the cores.
scripts.translation: 把核心給她看。

scripts.text:
[Elena Bolkova]
Did you found anything unusual?
I've already searched a lot of places in the mansion, and all of it were empty.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·博爾科娃]
發現什麼異常了嗎？我已經搜查過宅邸的很多地方，全都一無所獲。

scripts.text:
[Elena Bolkova]
What, so did you?
How do these guys avoid our eyes and keep making trouble?
It's very annoying.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·博爾科娃]
什麼，你也發現了？
